name: SynchronizeDirectories
label: Synchronize Directories
description: Synchronizes the local directory with a remote FTP directory.

fields.name: FtpConnection
fields.label: FTP Connection
fields.description: The FtpClient object representing an open connection to an FTP server.

fields.name: LocalDirectory
fields.label: Local Directory
fields.description: The local folder path to synchronize with the remote directory.

fields.name: RemoteDirectory
fields.label: Remote Directory
fields.description: The remote folder path to synchronize with the local directory.

fields.name: SyncMode
fields.label: Sync Mode
fields.description: Specifies whether to upload from local to remote, download from remote to local, or synchronize both ways.

selectOptions.label: Upload
selectOptions.description: Uploads files from local to remote only.

selectOptions.label: Download
selectOptions.description: Downloads files from remote to local only.

fields.name: FileComparisonMethod
fields.label: File Comparison Method
fields.description: Specifies how to determine if a file needs to be synchronized.

selectOptions.label: By Name and Size
selectOptions.description: Compares files by name and size.

selectOptions.label: By Name and Date
selectOptions.description: Compares files by name and last modified date.

fields.name: DeleteFilesNotPresentLocally
fields.label: Delete Files Not Present Locally
fields.description: If true, deletes files from the target location that are not present in the source.

fields.name: IncludeSubDirectories
fields.label: Include Subdirectories
fields.description: If true, includes subdirectories during synchronization.

selectOptions.label: If newer
selectOptions.description: Overwrite if remote file is newer.

selectOptions.label: If newer or size different
selectOptions.description: Overwrite if remote is newer or size differs.

fields.name: TimeoutSeconds
fields.label: Timeout Seconds
fields.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait before failing due to timeout.

fields.name: FilesTransferred
fields.label: Files Transferred
fields.description: Returns the number of files transferred during synchronization.

fields.name: DirectoriesCreated
fields.label: Directories Created
fields.description: Returns the number of directories created during synchronization.
